findings.description: Candidate checks for duplicate payloads rather than duplicate request IDs, violating the contract which requires unique request IDs.
findings.evidence: When events=[('r1','p1')], calling record(events,'r2','p1') incorrectly returns False (due to payload duplicate) but according to the specification it should return True and append the new event.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly enforces payload uniqueness instead of request ID uniqueness, causing failures when different requests share the same payload.
